title: APACER NOX 8GB DDR4 3200MHz Black Desktop Ram

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Boost Your PC's Performance with Apacer NOX 8GB DDR4 3200MHz Black Desktop RAM

Upgrade your system with the Apacer NOX 8GB DDR4 3200MHz RAM, designed for high-speed, stable performance and sleek aesthetics. With a high-frequency 3200MHz clock speed, this memory module enhances multitasking, gaming, and overall system responsiveness. The 8GB capacity is perfect for gamers, creators, and everyday users looking for a cost-effective performance boost. Its elegant black heat spreader ensures efficient thermal management while adding a stylish touch to your desktop build. Backed by Apacer’s reliability, the NOX series delivers a seamless and powerful computing experience.

Key Features – Apacer NOX 8GB DDR4 3200MHz Black Desktop RAM

  • High-Speed Performance: Operates at 3200MHz for faster data transfer and improved overall system responsiveness.
  • 8GB Capacity: Ideal for gaming, multitasking, and demanding desktop applications.
  • DDR4 Technology: Ensures greater energy efficiency and higher performance than DDR3 modules.
  • Low CAS Latency (CL16): Reduces delay in memory response for smoother system performance.
  • XMP 2.0 Support: Easy overclocking with pre-configured profiles for Intel-based systems.
  • Stylish Black Heatspreader: Sleek aluminum heatsink helps dissipate heat efficiently during high workloads.
  • Unbuffered and Non-ECC: Suitable for general consumer desktop use, not intended for servers.
  • Standard Voltage (1.35V): Balances power efficiency with performance output.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with most modern motherboards supporting DDR4 DIMM slots.
  • Lifetime Warranty: Reliable long-term investment with support from Apacer (varies by region).
